events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: Andy Reid's coaching return to Philadelphia was a success Thursday night as he guided the Kansas City Chiefs past the Eagles 26-16.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs (3-0) take down Eagles in Reid's return

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: Terence Newman returned a fumble 58 yards for a touchdown with 3:47 left, rallying the Cincinnati Bengals to a 34-30 victory over the Green Bay Packers in a game that came down to who made the final flub.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals rally past Packers in wild comeback

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: DeMarco Murray rushed for 175 yards and a touchdown, Tony Romo threw for three scores and the Dallas Cowboys beat the St. Louis Rams 31-7 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murray, Romo pace Cowboys in rout of Rams

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: Jake Locker threw a 34-yard touchdown pass to rookie Justin Hunter with 15 seconds left and the Tennessee Titans rallied to beat San Diego 20-17 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans edge Chargers on Locker's TD strike

headlines.description: Jordan Cameron caught three touchdown passes, including the go-ahead grab in the back of the end zone with 51 seconds left, and the Cleveland Browns kept the Minnesota Vikings winless with a 31-27 victory Sunday.

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw two touchdown passes to Kenbrell Thompkins, finally getting in sync with his rookie receivers and leading the New England Patriots to a 23-3 win over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady, rookie WRs click as Pats crush Bucs

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees passed for three scores and scrambled for New Orleans' first rushing touchdown of the season, leading the Saints to a 31-7 victory over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees scrambles for TD as Saints roll Cards

headlines.description: The Detroit Lions took advantage of a pair of fourth-quarter bobbles, including one by Robert Griffin III, in a 27-20 win over the Washington Redskins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions rally to drop RG III, Redskins to 0-3

events.name: New York Giants at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw three touchdown passes and ran for another, and Carolina's defense sacked Eli Manning seven times as the Panthers handed Tom Coughlin his worst defeat as coach of the New York Giants, 38-0 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers deal Giants worst loss of Coughlin era

headlines.description: Daryl Smith scored on a 37-yard interception return, Tandon Doss took a punt 82 yards for a touchdown and the Baltimore Ravens smothered the Houston Texans' offense in a 30-9 victory Sunday.
Ryan Tannehill lobbed a 1-yard touchdown pass to rookie tight end Dion Sims with 38 seconds left Sunday, and the unbeaten Miami Dolphins rallied past the Atlanta Falcons 27-23.

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New York Jets

headlines.description: Geno Smith threw two touchdown passes, including a go-ahead 69-yarder to Santonio Holmes in the fourth quarter, and the New York Jets overcame a team-record 20 penalties to hang on and beat the Buffalo Bills 27-20 in an ugly game Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets overcome sloppiness to dispatch Bills

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw for 164 yards and ran for a 6-yard touchdown while facing college coach Jim Harbaugh for the first time, and the Indianapolis Colts defeated the San Francisco 49ers 27-7 win Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck, Colts send Niners to 2nd straight loss

headlines.description: Russell Wilson matched his career high with four touchdown passes -- two each to Sidney Rice and Zach Miller -- and the Seattle Seahawks dominated as expected in a 45-17 win over the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson (4 TDs), Seahawks rough up Jaguars

headlines.description: Chicago's defense forced five turnovers and scored twice, and the Bears beat the Pittsburgh Steelers 40-23 on Sunday night to remain unbeaten.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bears force 5 turnovers, plow past Steelers

headlines.description: Peyton Manning threw for 374 yards and three touchdowns Monday to lift the Denver Broncos to another easy victory, 37-21 over the Oakland Raiders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peyton throws 3 TDs as Broncos rip Raiders
